seoTitle: Passive Voice and Long Sentence Checker
metaDescription: Highlight likely passive sentences and sentences that are too long in your English text, with counts and percentages. Free, in your browser.
intro: Flags sentences that look passive and sentences over a word limit, shows how many there are and the average sentence length.
why:
Passive sentences and very long sentences make text harder to follow. Counting them gives a quick sense of where to tighten.

It is a heuristic, not a grammar parser. It looks for a form of "to be" followed by a past participle, so it finds most simple passives but also flags some adjectives, and it misses others. Passive voice is not wrong: it is useful when the doer is unknown or unimportant. There is no search engine rule on sentence length.
howTo: Set what counts as a long sentence.
Rewrite flagged sentences where it helps the reader.

faq.q: Is passive voice bad for SEO?
faq.a: No search engine penalty is known. It is a style issue.

faq.q: Why is "She is tired" not flagged?
faq.a: The tool skips a few common adjective cases but not all of them.

faq.q: What is a good sentence length?
faq.a: There is no fixed rule. Many style guides suggest an average under about 20 words.
